decisions.rationale: Write tracking compares only exact string keys. A whole-variable assignment and an assignment to one of its indexed or field locations therefore evade the conflict check even though the writes overlap.

The target index is evaluated once for the write key and again during assignment, but the supplied excerpts do not establish that expression evaluation can produce different results or relevant side effects.

Unparsed clauses are grouped by declaration kind rather than globally ordered by source position. Consequently the reported first offending location can point after an earlier offending clause of the other kind.

The project parser accepts arbitrary whitespace, including a newline, between a property keyword and its name, while project detection requires the keyword and a literal following space on one line. Such accepted project syntax is routed to the wrong parser.

Header discovery does not retain string or comment lexical state. Numeric brace depth alone cannot reject a header-like token encountered in inert text, so text inside a string or comment can be treated as a real block.
This is materially the same block-scanner lexical-context defect adjudicated under adj:sha256:60d6ff36e9d8cb89e71f1bda2c3d31dbd6a0095469febebf70d73798fea4d21d.

top_lines updates nesting depth by counting brace characters without excluding quoted strings. A brace in a string-valued statement can corrupt depth and suppress or misclassify subsequent top-level statements.
find_comparator iterates every byte offset and slices the UTF-8 string at each offset. Any multibyte character causes slicing at a non-character boundary and can panic before a comparator is found.
This is materially the same UTF-8 byte-indexing defect in find_comparator adjudicated under adj:sha256:706c0f08d5ff96a508f966f6dc40366153ef554f735627824920676d69858dd8.

The selected property, including its parsed window and requirements, is passed intact to the evaluator. Without the evaluator contract or implementation, the excerpts do not establish that property defaults or comparison labels are ignored.
